description:
Leggi skill da art director e analizza selfrules.org come Art Director con 15+ anni di esperienza.

AUDIT RICHIESTO:
- Valuta coerenza visiva e storytelling attraverso il design
- Analizza se il visual comunica il posizionamento corretto
- Identifica gap tra "chi dice di essere" e "come appare"
- Verifica memorabilità: cosa resta impresso dopo 5 secondi?
- Confronta con personal brand di successo (trova riferimenti)

OUTPUT:
1. Assessment brutalmente onesto dell'identità visiva attuale
2. Cosa comunica il sito oggi vs cosa DOVREBBE comunicare
3. Creative direction per un rebrand che spacca
4. 3 concept visivi per elevare il brand al livello successivo

subtasks.description: Access selfrules.org and capture 5-second first impression test (attention grabbers, emotional response, memorability)
subtasks.notes: Completed 5-second first impression test. Created comprehensive first impressions document at output/01-first-impressions.md covering: attention grabbers (headline dominance, failure narrative), emotional responses (recognition, relief, trust, curiosity), memorability assessment (8/10), quality/value perception (premium-approachable), and visual style (neobrutalist, stripped-down). Key findings: strong verbal positioning but weaker visual brand mark.

subtasks.description: Document current visual elements: color palette usage, typography hierarchy, layout patterns, imagery style
subtasks.notes: Completed comprehensive visual elements documentation at output/02-visual-elements.md covering: 1) Color palette (6 primary brand colors + surfaces), 2) Typography hierarchy (3 font families, mobile-first scale), 3) Layout patterns (8pt grid, container widths, breakpoints, brutalist borders/shadows), 4) Imagery style analysis (minimal/absent - typography-driven design with geometric shapes and icons only), 5) Component pattern summary, 6) Visual element gaps identified (no logo, no photography, duplicate components), 7) Design System Health Score: 6.7/10. Key findings: Strong typographic system but weak visual content strategy.

subtasks.description: Review design system baseline from tailwind.config.ts and compare against live implementation
subtasks.notes: Design system baseline review completed. Found critical fragmentation issues: duplicate component systems (6 components), shadow value mismatches, mixed token usage. Overall adherence score: 6.3/10. Deliverable: output/03-design-system-baseline.md. Commit: 05a575c

subtasks.description: Analyze visual hierarchy using Z/F-pattern eye flow mapping, identify focal points (must be clear within 3 sec)
subtasks.notes: Completed Z-Pattern and F-Pattern eye flow mapping analysis. Created comprehensive visual hierarchy document at output/04-visual-hierarchy-analysis.md. Key findings: (1) Primary focal point passes 3-second test at ~2.5s, (2) Overall hierarchy score 7.8/10, (3) Strong typography/color hierarchy, (4) Weaknesses in visual brand anchoring and competing decorative elements. Commit pending.

subtasks.description: Calculate Brand Consistency Score (/25): Logo usage, Color adherence, Typography, Imagery style, Voice & tone (each /5)
subtasks.notes: Brand Consistency Score calculated: 18.5/25 (74%). Breakdown: Logo Usage 2.5/5 (functional but not iconic), Color Adherence 4.0/5 (strong semantic system), Typography 4.5/5 (excellent hierarchy), Imagery Style 3.0/5 (lacks photography), Voice & Tone 4.5/5 (authentic and distinctive). Key issues: logo needs visual memorability, floating shapes need opacity reduction, design system has minor fragmentation. Deliverable: output/05-brand-consistency-score.md. Commit: 64ba8ee

subtasks.description: Evaluate cross-touchpoint consistency: Homepage, Blog, About/Journey, Contact/CTA sections
subtasks.notes: Reading all touchpoint files (Homepage, sections, Header, Footer, UI components) to evaluate cross-touchpoint consistency

subtasks.description: Conduct gap analysis: 'What site says' vs 'What site shows' - identify authenticity disconnects
Research 3-5 successful personal brand websites for benchmarking comparison
Analyze competitor positioning, visual execution, and differentiation factors
Rate Voice Dimensions (1-10): Formality, Energy, Humor, Authority - compare against benchmarks
Develop Creative Direction Brief: Objective, audience, core message, tone/mood, mandatories, anti-inspirations
Create 3 distinct Visual Concepts with: name, rationale, visual elements, emotional target, implementation notes, risk/benefit
Reconstruct positioning statement using template: For [TARGET] who [NEED], [BRAND] is the [CATEGORY] that [BENEFIT] because [PROOF]
Compile Executive Summary: Overall quality assessment, top 3 issues, 10x opportunity identification
Create Visual Hierarchy Table with element-by-element effectiveness ratings
Develop Priority Action Plan: Quick wins (<1 day), Strategic (1-2 weeks), Transformational (1+ months)
Finalize all 7 deliverables into structured audit report
